summary: This bill amends the Tariff Act of 1930 to strengthen antidumping and countervailing duty laws by establishing new rules for successive investigations, addressing market distortions and cross-border subsidies, preventing circumvention of duties, countering currency undervaluation, and enhancing enforcement against duty evasion.

scores.thoughts: This bill is entirely focused on amending the Tariff Act of 1930 to strengthen antidumping and countervailing duty laws. It aims to make it easier to impose duties on imported goods that are deemed to be unfairly priced or subsidized, and to prevent circumvention and evasion of these duties. This is a protectionist stance, as it seeks to shield domestic industries from foreign competition through trade remedies.
